title: Naramata Half Day Wine Tour (Incl. Tasting Fees & Guide Grat!)
includes: Door to door pick up and drop off in Penticton Area
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Get ready to sip and savor on the stunning Naramata Bench Wine Trail, where breathtaking views, boutique wineries, and vineyards stretch as far as the eye can see! Just a stone’s throw from Penticton, our wine tours whisk you through 14 kilometers of scenic country roads that overlook the gorgeous Okanagan Lake. With rolling hills, diverse soils, and cool lake breezes, Naramata Bench is Canada’s grape-growing paradise. Whether you're a fan of bold reds or crisp whites, you’ll find your perfect pour here. Join us for a half-day adventure on the Half Day Sip Disturber tour, where you'll taste up to 20 fabulous wines at 4 award-winning wineries from the list provided. Cheers to a sip-disturbingly good time!
